name: Mango Habanero Gobi
menu_role: Appetizer / shareable (Core 5; D-84: not a taco, no tortilla)
cooking_method: Blanch about 3 min, steam-dry, coat thinly, roast hot (about 200 °C) to dark tips, toss with warm glaze to order; fried-batter comparison arm kept as a test variant

portion.description: 1 shareable plate (cauliflower visible and recognisable, D-84)
portion.construction: roast-first v1.0 (keeps visible floret structure and avoids a fried-chicken look); batter-fry arm in v1.1 as a documented variant

lines.prep: florets about 4-5 cm with stem attached

steps: Day before: make glaze and raita-crema; cut florets (store dry, covered, ≤ 5 °C).
Blanch florets about 3 min in salted boiling water; drain and steam-dry until the surface is dry (needed for coating to stick and to brown).
Toss with the yogurt-besan-spice film (thin; it should cling, not pool).
Roast on a perforated or hot tray at about 200 °C, not crowded, turning once, until the tips are dark and stems cream (about 14-18 min; ASSUMPTION: measure).
Toss with warmed glaze (≥ 70 °C) to order, plate within 60 s; lime and cilantro; dip on the side.

critical_parameters.crunch_gate: design assumption: crunch retained about 10 min (NOT TESTED)

plating: Shareable shallow bowl or plate: florets heaped so cauliflower structure is visible, glaze glossy and clinging (not pooled), dark roasted tips showing through, cilantro leaves and one lime wedge, dip in a small cup beside. Nothing else on the plate.
equipment: Convection oven or combi (roast), perforated trays
Steam/blanch pot and ice or dry-rack for steam-drying
Fryer only for the batter variant
food_safety: Cool the glaze within the 2 h + 4 h limits (cooling rule) and reheat to at least 74 °C if it has been cooled.
Habanero handling: gloves, no touching eyes; label heat level.
Roasted florets held for service must be kept hot (≥ 57 °C) and discarded after the written hold time; crispness degrades long before safety limits (hold time is a measured attribute: T+0/5/10).
Vegetarian dish with dairy: keep dairy cross-contact in mind in shared fryers if the batter variant is used.

day_before: Cook and cool glaze (batch 450 g ≈ 8 portions)
morning: Cut florets; blanch, steam-dry and coat per forecast (coat late)
service: Roast per order in rolling batches (14-18 min)
Toss with glaze, plate within 60 s
workflow.capacity_note: oven time per batch is the constraint; batch-roast two trays ahead at peak and re-crisp

pairing.hypothesis: Mango in the glaze echoes the beer's mango-forward aroma; juicy body and low perceived bitterness soften habanero heat.
pairing.risk: Sweet-on-sweet; hop bitterness plus capsaicin can amplify burn; target ABV also raises perceived heat.
pairing.status: PAIRING HYPOTHESIS - NOT SENSORY TESTED; the beer does not exist yet

pairing.hypothesis: High carbonation and soft wheat body reset the palate between glazed bites.
pairing.risk: Banana ester next to mango sweetness may read fruity-on-fruity. The existing matrix uses Pilsner as the deliberate counter-test (PF-02).
pairing.status: PAIRING HYPOTHESIS - NOT SENSORY TESTED; the beer does not exist yet

photography.hero: Three-quarter angle, shallow bowl, warm evening side light, dark ceramic or stone surface, slight steam only if freshly roasted.
must_show: cauliflower florets with stems attached, obviously cauliflower
dark roasted tips and cream-coloured stems showing through a glossy orange-amber glaze
glaze clinging in thin streaks, not a thick sauce pool
fresh cilantro leaves, a lime wedge, a small cup of white raita-crema
must_not_show: battered nugget look or a uniform golden fried coating (that is the v1.1 variant, label it if shown)
microgreens, black sesame seeds, crushed nuts or any garnish not in the recipe (the first concept image had these: they are NOT in this recipe)
any text, logo or menu card
photography.realism_notes: Roasted cauliflower dries and browns unevenly: show irregular char, some floret edges dark, glaze catching light. Habanero is in the glaze, not on top.
photography.label: Conceptual food visualization — AI-generated concept art, not a photograph and not a tested menu item.

allergen_notes: Milk (yogurt coating, raita-crema). Chickpea (besan) is not a major US allergen: check the label for wheat cross-contact; if the batter variant uses flour or a shared fryer, wheat must be added. Mango puree: check for sulfites. No allergen-free and no gluten-free claim.
